column1: # The execution checks a GitHub runner cannot run, recorded against the commit

# release-gate CI job runs on every v* tag and which REFUSES a record whose
# commit is not the commit being released.
# Produced by tests/record_local_execution_checks.sh. Do not hand-edit.
